entities.name: DoubleZero
entities.gloss: A destructive wiper malware developed in C# that overwrites files and registry hives.

entities.name: UAC-0088

entities.name: Windows
entities.gloss: A family of proprietary graphical operating systems developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: Україна
